CustomField.description: String field display override (#250, #249), following the per-datatype *Type__c override family (picklistType__c, longTextType__c, richTextType__c). standard renders the normal single-line input; textarea renders the string as a lightning-textarea honoring textAreaMinHeight__c / textAreaMaxHeight__c. Selector values (icon, form component, email template, image asset, style sheet) are offered dynamically in Form Builder only for fields whose API name matches the selector's semantic pattern; the chosen selector writes a plain string value that rides the form's normal save.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Overrides how a text field displays on the form. Text Area renders a multi-line input with configurable minimum and maximum height. Selector options appear only for fields whose API name matches the selector's purpose.
CustomField.label: stringType
